author: EyMoose
body:
I got on today and saw that I was banned for Hacking. I never use hacks as I believe cheating is stupid. I do not know or remember why I got banned. If anyone can help me or tell me what I can do to get back from this ban please reply.
Thanks staff for reading this post,
iz

title: Is This where I appeal my ban?

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello there iz,

You were permanently banned for Hacking- KillAura and Anti-Knockback. 
This is the correct place if you wish the appeal your infraction then please make a formal reply, using this layout:
  • Your minecraft username 
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned
  • Why you should be unbanned
Kind regards,
-Blizz
